snippet.title: SlashZero - Early Playtest Gameplay - Wishlist and Playtest now
snippet.description:
Get a closer look at SlashZero — a 3D action roguelike platformer. https://store.steampowered.com/app/4061170/SlashZero/
Early Playtest is now available on Steam with 2 playable characters to choose from. As a Timehacker, your job is to travel across timelines and explore a cyberpunk world. Unleash flashy moves, dive into thrilling combat and customize endless builds to suit your playstyle. 
Follow our social media to learn more. 
X: https://x.com/SlashZeroGame
Discord: https://discord.gg/Jxj7EakJw3
